text:
## Step 12: Quality Assurance & Closure  
### QA Checklist  
**Before Closing Change Request:**  
- [ ] Customer identity verified ✓
- [ ] New address validated (format, postcode) ✓
- [ ] AML risk assessed ✓
- [ ] AML screening completed (if required) ✓
- [ ] Proof of address obtained & verified (if required) ✓
- [ ] KYC records updated ✓
- [ ] Core system (AMS) updated ✓
- [ ] Standing orders reviewed & updated (if needed) ✓
- [ ] Direct Debits reviewed & updated (if needed) ✓
- [ ] Statement delivery updated ✓
- [ ] Data warehouse updated ✓
- [ ] Customer notified (email, SMS, letter) ✓
- [ ] Change documented in system ✓
- [ ] No exceptions/escalations outstanding ✓  
**If Any Item Not Checked:**
- Don't close change request
- Complete outstanding items
- Document reason for delay
- Escalate if blocked >3 business days

raw_entities.name: Address Change Request Process
raw_entities.description: The operational workflow for updating a customer's address, encompassing identity verification, AML assessment, system updates across core and data warehouse platforms, and final quality assurance closure.

raw_entities.name: Quality Assurance and Closure Review
raw_entities.description: The final verification stage where a comprehensive checklist is reviewed to ensure all identity, AML, and system updates are completed before the change request is closed.

raw_entities.name: Process Owner/Reviewer
raw_entities.description: The individual responsible for executing the QA checklist, updating systems (AMS and Data Warehouse), and ensuring all outstanding items are completed before closing the request.

raw_entities.name: QA Checklist Completion Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision point where the process either proceeds to closure if all checklist items are verified or is halted to complete outstanding items and document delays.

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger for Blocked Requests
raw_entities.description: A condition where a change request is escalated if it remains blocked for more than 3 business days.

raw_entities.name: Operational Escalation Tier
raw_entities.description: The level of authority engaged when a change request is blocked for more than 3 business days.

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory control point ensuring the customer's identity has been successfully verified before the address change is finalized.

raw_entities.name: AML Risk and Screening Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A regulatory gate verifying that the AML risk has been assessed and screening has been completed as required.

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Verification Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A control point to confirm the new address is validated for format and postcode, and that required proof of address documents have been obtained and verified.
context: Proof of address obtained & verified (if required) ✓

raw_entities.name: KYC Record Update Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A verification gate ensuring that the customer's Know Your Customer records have been updated to reflect the changes.

raw_entities.name: Address Change Applicant
raw_entities.description: The bank customer whose identity is being verified and whose address is being updated in the core systems.

raw_entities.name: Customer Account Records
raw_entities.description: The customer account records held within the AMS and data warehouse that require updating for the new address.

raw_entities.name: Associated Standing Orders
raw_entities.description: Standing orders linked to the account that must be reviewed and updated as part of the address change process.

raw_entities.name: Associated Direct Debits
raw_entities.description: Direct Debit mandates linked to the account that must be reviewed and updated during the address change process.
